status: prospective bounded operational qualification; freeze source and tests before outcomes

qualification.primary: Healthy equal/uneven weighted calls per confirmed useful result, with all dispatched attempts conservatively charged and fresh confirmation included; require resolved positive saving versus strict using simultaneous bounds.
qualification.operational: No unsampled candidate charges; no confirmation after incomplete search or stale resume; strict reference and lazy same-path maxima fit their frozen reservations; compatible resume uses the existing original sample and adds its pause once, with no age reset.
qualification.usefulness: Healthy and mildly degraded complete-workflow success reported with simultaneous uncertainty. Original 80% per-position promotion floor retained; uncertainty overlapping the floor remains unresolved, not a pass.
qualification.risk: Applicable conditional fresh-confirmation error at most .055, selected-result publication-risk excess versus strict at most .005. Use the constant-rate independent completed-arm component bound for conditional error. For a null category with one fixed candidate-rate component, publication probability equals its complete-selected probability times the fresh component error; multiply simultaneous selection-probability bounds by diagnostic component-error bounds to assess excess. Refuse this factorization for mixed components. Keep realized paired publication intervals separately and report their insufficient precision.
qualification.expiry: Lifetime endpoint exclusive; expiration may lower completion and usefulness and must forbid classification/confirmation, rather than count as behavioral loss. Refuse unsupported remaining-time models.
qualification.drift_scope: One shared downward step during search; prove every eligible confirmation starts after the step. Drift within final confirmation, continuous hosted drift and detection guarantees are unsupported.
qualification.stop: Select a bounded synthetically qualified sharing design or actionable course correction, with implementation burden assessed separately. No outcome from this simulation establishes native eligibility, safe replacement, timing, tokens, or paid savings.
